reference.adaptation: Independent implementation in the existing V2 four-layer bilibili chain (no V1 tools/bilibili reuse, no new source file): pure domain TTL+LRU snapshot cache and cache key; application read path owns policy, credential-generation scope and invalidation. delivered: domain/bilibili.py: READ_CACHE_TTL_S = {video: 86400.0, whois: 86400.0} (the ONLY cacheable operations); READ_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=400, READ_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=8MiB, READ_CACHE_MAX_ENTRY_BYTES=64KiB; read_cache_key(agent_id, config_id, credential authority, operation, target, limit) with strict component validation; ReadCache TTL+LRU over canonical JSON snapshots (insertion order preserved so a hit serializes byte-identically), get returns an independent copy, put rejects invalid TTL / oversized / non-JSON values without failing the read, discard_scope(agent,config) drops every generation, discard_generations(agent,config,authority) drops retired credential generations, clear(); no I/O, no clock reads

application/bilibili.py: read path computes authority via existing bilibili_read_authorized (config revision + credential revision + authority_epoch) and calls discard_generations before lookup, so a rotated credential purges older snapshots; on a hit it re-checks bilibili_read_authorized(revision_id) and only serves when authority is unchanged (otherwise discards the scope and falls through to a live read); risk pause gate and configuration revocation run BEFORE the cache; failures/risk codes are never cached; a successful live read is stored only after the post-read authority CAS passes; health() adds read_cache_entries/read_cache_bytes; stop_accepting clears the cache; optional clock/cache keyword-only constructor args (composition unchanged)

Non-cacheable endpoints pinned by regression: account, comments, replies, search, relation, danmaku, popular, ranking, following, favorites, tags, history, msgfeed are read live on every call and never stored; READ_SPEC enum minus READ_CACHE_TTL_S is asserted against that explicit list
nav is never cached (documented as deliberately stricter than the reference 10min nav cache); media read_source (subtitle/streams) bypasses this cache because it calls the gateway directly
No new table/migration/route/worker protocol frame/shared port signature/new source file; declared_tools unchanged
